title: 14 Days Southern Tanzania Birding Tour
summary: Deep south circuits combining miombo, riverine forest and open woodland targets.

itinerary.title: Iringa
itinerary.description: Alive at Iringa and you will meet our guide at the airport. This day you will do birding around Iringa town and you will overnight at Iringa town at Neema craft. On this evening you will do the itinerary review with your guide.

itinerary.title: Iringa- Hill Top lodge
itinerary.description: – waking up 600 and you will have a breakfast at the hotel, and then you will start your trip toward Ruaha national park. Birding on the road all the way to the lodge, where you will have a lunch, after lunch you will have 2 hours break. After break you will have a soft drink then you will go for the evening birding around the lodge. Back to the lodge for refreshment. Dinner it will be at the lodge. After dinner you will do the review with your guide.

itinerary.title: Hill top- Ruaha National Park
itinerary.description: – waking up 600, then breakfast at the lodge. After breakfast then we will start driving to Ruaha National Park gate. The guide he will do all the payment and you will continues with birding and game driving to your accommodation, where you will have a lunch. Birding and animal experience it will be on the evening. Dinner and overnight it will be at Ruaha River Lodge.

itinerary.title: Ruaha national park
itinerary.description: – Full day inside the national with pack lunch, and we will be spending most of our time on the acacia woodland and river line for the water birds. We will come back at the lodge for the dinner. After dinner we will do the review for the day.

itinerary.title: Ruaha national park
itinerary.description: – Full day inside the park. We will do our birding on the different habitat (Miombo Woodland) for the Miombo special.

itinerary.title: Ruaha national park
itinerary.description: Full day in the park. We will have a park lunch.

itinerary.title: Ruaha np-kisolanza oldfarm
itinerary.description: Breakfast at the Ruaha River Lodge , then we will do a short birding inside the national park then we will start driving back towards Iringa town where we will have a lunch at Neema Craft. After lunch we will drive to Old Kisolanza farm for the evening birding around the farm and we will overnight at Old farm Kisolanza.

itinerary.title: Kisolanza old farm
itinerary.description: Full day birding at Kisolanza swamp and on the Miombo Woodland.

itinerary.title: Kisolanza-Mufindi
itinerary.description: we will live early in the morning to Mufindi Fish Lodge, the drive it will take 2 hours birding speed. We will spend most of our day in the rain forest and we will be doing birding. Lunch it will be packed and dinner we will have at the lodge where we will overnight

itinerary.title: Mufindi fish lodge
itinerary.description: Full day birding on the rain forest and on the swamps. Lunch and dinner it will be at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Mufindi – Iringa tawn
itinerary.description: waking up 600, then you will have a breakfast at the lodge, and we will have a park lunch. After breakfast we will start driving towards Iringa town via Kiponzero swamp. Lunch at Kiponzero swamp. Birding it will be taking place on the road and at Kiponzero swamp. Dinner it will be at Iringa town (Neema Craft)

itinerary.title: Iringa-uluti (udzungwa scap
itinerary.description: )-It will be a day trip- waking up 500 then you will have a coffee at the lodge, after coffee we will start driving toward Dabaga, then Uluti village. We will have a park lunch. Birding it will be inside the forest. Dinner it will be at ( Neema Craft)

liveListingTitle: 14 DAYS SOUTHERN TANZANIA BIRDING TOUR

title: 19 Days Southern Tanzania Birding Trip
summary: Extended southern exploration with extra time in key endemism zones.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.description: Meat at Iringa town and we will drive to Mufindi forest. From Iringa town to Mufindi it will take 2-3 hours if we will be doing birding on the way. When we get to the lodge we will have time for birding at the forest which is around the lodge or guest house. This place is known as home of these birds down here on list:

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.description: Wake up early in morning and start birding from 6:30am, our areas will be in forest around lodge /guest house. Our birding will take 2-3 hours before we back for breakfast. After breakfast we will be driving around different location toward big forest for the forest specias. On this day you may have chance to see same species of day one or can be more new species. Lunch will be saving on way because lunch boxes will be with us on car. After short break of lunch will continue with birding until evening when we get back to dinner and shower. Overnight will be at the same place.

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.description: Wake up early in morning and put in car all our belongings and leave around 6:30am.This will be long day driving to Songea Region on the miombo woodland for miombo special. Breakfast will be saving on the way at Makambako town which will be around 8:30am.

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.description: After breakfast will continue with driving while we doing birding on the way until we reach the campsite which will be between Njombe and Songea border.

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.description: Lunch will be saving at the campsite.

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.description: It will take us 5-6 hours to the campsite. On this day will be a bush camping. In the afternoon we will do birding around the campsite and back for dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.description: Wake up early in morning and start birding 6:30am around the camp site for 3 hours then back to the camp for breakfast. After breakfast everything will be parked in car ready to drive more into the miombo woodland for more species. Lunch will be saving on the way.

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.description: Then drive back to Songea town in evening for dinner and shower

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.description: Overnight at Songea heritage cottage.

itinerary.title: Day 10
itinerary.description: After wake up we will have breakfast before to leave. On this day will be more drive to south west toward Mozambique border for the Lillian’s lovebird and rock prantincole. This is a so complicated day. Birding on the way and we will have lunch on the road when we get to the good miombo. We will do a bush camp for a one day.

itinerary.title: Day 11
itinerary.description: Early in morning birding for 2 hours around campsite then will back for breakfast. Put all our staff in car and drive to songea for shopping and we will have a lunch, at songea after we will drive west part of Selous GR when we gate to the GR or at the campsite, we will do evening birding around the camp site. This will be another bush camping.

itinerary.title: Day 12
itinerary.description: As normal in early morning birding around campsite from 6:30am. After 2 p to 3 hours will back for breakfast then drive Tunduru town for lunch and after lunch we will drive to lukwati lumesule Game reserve. This game reserve is one of the most southern game reserves in the country and its lay on the Ruvuma River. We will overnight inside the game reserve.

itinerary.title: Day 13
itinerary.description: Wake up in morning and do birding around the game reserve for 2 to 3 hours before breakfast. After that we will drive to Masasi. Lunch will be saving on the way outside the game reserve. Then drive straight to Masasi town for Overnight

itinerary.title: Day 14
itinerary.description: Also will buy some staffs which we miss on our food list.

itinerary.title: Day 15
itinerary.description: Drive to Rondo plateau, but we will bird on the way to rondo, lunch at the age of the plateau or at the camp site. We will bird around the game reserve. Overnight at Rondo plateau

itinerary.title: Day 16
itinerary.description: Birding around rondo this it will be done by walking before breakfast, after breakfast we will drive into the forest and stop when we see a good please forest birding. Around 1330 we will come back to the camp site for lunch. Then we will have a break. After break we will do birding up to diner evening time.

itinerary.title: Day 17
itinerary.description: This it will be another long day off drive to Kirwa town. Still were on the birding tripe so soon we see a good spot for a birding we will stop for that. Overnight at kirwa town.

itinerary.title: Day 18
itinerary.description: We will do birding along the cost for ocean. After morning birding we will drive back to Dar salaam. It’s another long day of driving. Overnight at Dar salaam. END OF TRIP

title: 10-Day Birding Safaris Northern and Eastern Tanzania
summary: Ten-day birding safari combining northern and eastern Tanzania habitats.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport and transfer to your lodge in Arusha. Spend the day relaxing and birdwatching around the lodge grounds, where you may spot species such as African Black Duck and Silvery-cheeked Hornbill.

itinerary.title: Arusha National Park
itinerary.description: Depart for Arusha National Park early in the morning. Explore the park’s diverse habitats, including montane forests and savannahs. Look for birds like the Bar-tailed Trogon, Grey-crowned Crane, and various sunbirds. Enjoy a picnic lunch amidst nature.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: Travel to Tarangire National Park, known for its large elephant herds and baobab trees. Birdwatching highlights include the Ashy Starling, Yellow-collared Lovebird, and various raptors. Spend the night at a lodge within or near the park.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: Continue exploring Tarangire with a full day of birding. Focus on different areas of the park to maximize your sightings. Look for species such as the Rufous-tailed Weaver and various migratory birds depending on the season.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.description: Head to Lake Manyara National Park, famous for its diverse ecosystems ranging from wetlands to woodlands. Birdwatchers can expect to see flamingos, pelicans, and many other waterfowl along with forest species like the Great Blue Turaco.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: Travel to Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage site. While primarily known for its wildlife, birdwatchers can find unique species here such as the Kori Bustard and various raptors soaring above. Overnight at a lodge overlooking the crater.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.description: Spend another day in the Ngorongoro region focusing on highland birds. Explore areas around Empakaai Crater or Olmoti Crater where you can find endemic species like the Usambara Eagle-Owl and other montane birds.

itinerary.title: Selous Game Reserve (Nyerere National Park)
itinerary.description: Depart for Selous Game Reserve (now Nyerere National Park), one of Africa’s largest protected areas. The reserve is home to numerous bird species including African Fish Eagles and various kingfishers along riversides.

itinerary.title: Selous Game Reserve (Nyerere National Park)
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day of birding in Selous with options for boat safaris on the Rufiji River where you can observe aquatic birds as well as mammals. Look out for rare sightings such as Pel’s Fishing Owl.

itinerary.title: Departure from Dar es Salaam
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel to Dar es Salaam for your departure flight or extend your trip with an optional visit to Pemba Island or Zanzibar if time allows.

title: 10 Days South West Tanzania
summary: South-west Tanzania birding route listed on endemicbirds.co.tz.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mpanda
itinerary.description: Arrive in Mpanda either air from Dar es salama, then you will meet your guide drive at the Airstrip, from their you will drive to your accommodation then the drive he/she will give you a briefing for the next day’s according to your trip or the itinerary. Explore the town and prepare for the upcoming journey. Overnight stay in Mpanda.

itinerary.title: Mpanda to Katavi National Park
itinerary.description: Depart early morning for Katavi National Park (approximately 2 hours’ drive). Spend the day exploring the park known for its diverse wildlife including elephants, hippos, and various bird species. Overnight camping or lodge accommodation within or near the park.

itinerary.title: Full Day at Katavi National Park
itinerary.description: Continue exploring Katavi with guided game drives. Visit specific areas like Katisunga Plains and Lake Katavi. Overnight stay at the same accommodation.

itinerary.title: Katavi to Lake Tanganyika
itinerary.description: Depart from Katavi heading towards Lake Tanganyika (approximately 3 hours’ drive). Enjoy activities such as swimming, fishing, or relaxing by the lake. Overnight stay at a lakeside lodge or campsite.

itinerary.title: Lake Tanganyika to Ufipa Plateau
itinerary.description: Leave Lake Tanganyika early morning for Ufipa Plateau (approximately 2 hours’ drive). Explore the plateau’s scenic views and local culture. Consider visiting nearby villages to experience local life. Overnight stay on the Ufipa Plateau.

itinerary.title: Ufipa Plateau to Kalambo Falls
itinerary.description: Depart for Kalambo Falls (approximately 1.5 hours’ drive). Visit one of Africa’s highest waterfalls; enjoy hiking around the area. Take time to appreciate the natural beauty and photography opportunities. Overnight stay near Kalambo Falls.

itinerary.title: Kalambo Falls to Tunduma
itinerary.description: Travel from Kalambo Falls to Tunduma (approximately 1-hour drive). Explore Tunduma town; this is also a border town with Zambia which can be interesting for cultural exchange. Overnight stay in Tunduma.

itinerary.title: Tunduma to Kitulo National Park
itinerary.description: Depart early morning for Kitulo National Park (approximately 2 hours’ drive). Spend the day exploring this unique park known for its stunning wildflower displays and biodiversity. Engage in guided walks through flower fields and enjoy birdwatching opportunities. Overnight camping or lodge accommodation within or near Kitulo NP.

itinerary.title: Full Day at Kitulo National Park
itinerary.description: Continue exploring Kitulo with more extensive hikes or nature walks. Visit specific sites like Mount Rungwe if time permits. Overnight stay at the same accommodation.

itinerary.title: Kitulo NP to Mbeya
itinerary.description: Depart from Kitulo NP heading towards Mbeya (approximately 1.5 hours’ drive). Arrive in Mbeya; explore local markets or historical sites if time allows.

title: 9 Days Birding – Mahale, Gombe, Burigi-Chato & Minziro Forest
summary: Western forest and lake-region birding across Mahale, Gombe, Burigi-Chato and Minziro.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mahale National Park
itinerary.description: Arrive at the nearest airstrip or port and transfer to your accommodation. Spend the afternoon relaxing and acclimatizing to the environment. In the evening, enjoy a guided night walk to observe nocturnal bird species.

itinerary.title: Birding in Mahale National Park
itinerary.description: Early morning birdwatching session in the park’s diverse habitats. Look for species such as the African Fish Eagle (Haliaeetus vocifer) and various sunbirds. After lunch, take a boat trip on Lake Tanganyika to spot waterbirds like herons and kingfishers. Evening at leisure with an optional discussion on bird identification techniques.

itinerary.title: Gombe Stream National Park
itinerary.description: Depart early for Gombe Stream National Park, known for its rich biodiversity. Engage in birdwatching along the trails; target species include the Blue Monjita (Cyanomitra cyanolaema) and Olive Sunbird (Cyanomitra olivacea). Enjoy a picnic lunch amidst nature before continuing your exploration. Return to your accommodation for dinner and share your sightings of the day.

itinerary.title: Birding in Gombe Stream National Park
itinerary.description: Full day of birdwatching in Gombe. Focus on different trails to maximize species diversity. Look out for primate interactions while observing birds; this park is famous for its chimpanzees as well. Evening debrief with fellow birders to discuss findings and experiences.

itinerary.title: Travel to Burigi-Chato National Park
itinerary.description: Depart from Gombe early morning and travel towards Burigi-Chato National Park. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation and prepare for an afternoon of exploration. Take a short evening walk around the park’s entrance area to spot local birds.

itinerary.title: Birding in Burigi-Chato National Park
itinerary.description: Spend a full day exploring Burigi-Chato’s diverse habitats including wetlands and forests. Target species include the Shoebill (Balaeniceps rex), Red-faced Barbet (Lybius rubrifacies), and migratory birds like Great Snipe (Gallinago media). Participate in guided walks focusing on specific areas known for high bird activity.

itinerary.title: Travel to Minziro Forest Reserve
itinerary.description: Depart from Burigi-Chato early morning heading towards Minziro Forest Reserve. After settling into accommodations, embark on an introductory birdwatching session within the reserve’s unique ecosystem.

itinerary.title: Birding in Minziro Forest Reserve
itinerary.description: Full day dedicated to exploring Minziro Forest. Focus on identifying endemic species found only within Kagera region such as various forest specials not seen elsewhere in Tanzania. Engage with local guides who can provide insights into both flora and fauna of this unique habitat. Evening discussions about conservation efforts related to logging impacts on local avifauna.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Depending on flight schedules, enjoy one last morning of birdwatching or relax before departing from Minziro Forest back home or onward travel destinations.

title: 8 Days Birding Around Iringa
summary: Regional birding around Iringa including Kiponzero, Kisolanza, Uluti and Mufindi as listed on the live site.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Iringa
itinerary.description: Arrive at Iringa and check into your accommodation. Spend the afternoon birding around the local area to acclimatize and spot common species such as the African Paradise Flycatcher and various weavers.

itinerary.title: Kiponzero Swamp
itinerary.description: Early morning departure to Kiponzero Swamp. Birding activities focusing on wetland species. Look for birds like the locust finch, fuellborn’s longclaw, rosy-throated longclaw, African snipe, gray-rumped swallow, Lesser Jacana, African Marsh Harrier, and various Cisticolas. Afternoon return to Iringa for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Uluti Forest
itinerary.description: Depart early for Uluti Forest. Explore the forest trails while searching for forest specials such as the Livingstone’s Turaco, Iringa akalat, white-chested alethe, dapple-throat, swynnerton’s robin, white-winged apalis, rufous-winged sunbird and other endemic species. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the forest before continuing birding until late afternoon. Return to Iringa for dinner.

itinerary.title: Kisolanza Farm
itinerary.description: Morning drive to Kisolanza Farm. Birding around the farm area where you can find species like the Yellow-browed Seedeater and Uhehe Fiscal. Spend time observing both birds and local agricultural practices. Overnight stay at Kisolanza Farm.

itinerary.title: Mufindi Forest
itinerary.description: Depart for Mufindi Forest after breakfast. Engage in slow-paced birding throughout the day. Target species include Miombo Warbler, and various sunbirds. Take breaks to enjoy the scenic views of the highlands and possibly spot some mammals like Syke’s Monkey or bushbucks.

itinerary.title: Mufindi Highlands Exploration
itinerary.description: Full day of birding in Mufindi Highlands. Focus on highland specialties such as Iringa Akalat and Livingstone Flycatcher. Explore different habitats within the highlands including grasslands and wooded areas.

itinerary.title: Return to Iringa
itinerary.description: Morning birding session in Mufindi before heading back to Iringa. Stop at any promising locations along the way for additional birdwatching opportunities.

itinerary.title: Departure from Iringa
itinerary.description: Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy a final morning of birdwatching around Iringa or visit local markets before departing.

itinerary.title: Rungwe to Bitimanyanga

itinerary.title: Bitimanyanga to Chunya

itinerary.title: Chunya to Kituro

itinerary.title: Kituro to Mbeya

title: 10-Day Birdwatching Safari in Northern Tanzania
summary: Northern Tanzania birdwatching safari combining specialist birding with classic wildlife landscapes.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be greeted by a representative who will assist you with your transfer to Arusha Town. You will stay overnight at Ilboru Safari Lodge, where you will receive a briefing about the upcoming birdwatching tour.

itinerary.title: Arusha National Park
itinerary.description: The day begins with pre-breakfast birdwatching around the lodge grounds, where you may spot various species such as fire finches and variable sunbirds. After breakfast, you’ll head to Arusha National Park for a full day of birding. The park is home to diverse bird species including Macoa ducks, Egyptian Geese, and Trogons. A walking safari will also provide opportunities to see White Fronted Bee-eaters and the rare Spike-heeled Lark.

itinerary.title: Journey to Serengeti
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, you will embark on a long drive to the Serengeti National Park. During the journey, keep an eye out for Sand grouses and guinea fowls. Upon arrival in the evening, check into Ikoma Bush Tented Camp for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Birdwatching in Serengeti
itinerary.description: Start your day with a pre-breakfast bird walk focusing on Tanzanian endemics like Fischer’s Lovebird and Grey-breasted Spurfowl. After breakfast, continue exploring the Serengeti for more bird species such as Usambiro Barbets and Grey-capped Social Weavers throughout the day.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: Depart from the Serengeti after breakfast and drive into Ngorongoro Crater. Here, look for endemic birds like Rufous-tailed Weaver and Golden-winged Sunbird while also enjoying sightings of large mammals such as elephants and various raptors soaring above.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel to Lake Manyara National Park known for its tree-climbing lions and diverse wildlife. Enjoy a picnic lunch within the park before continuing your exploration of its jungles where you can add more species to your list.

itinerary.title: Optional Activities at E Unoto Retreat
itinerary.description: You have the option for an early morning bird walk or spend the day game viewing in Lake Manyara or relaxing at your lodge with excellent birding opportunities from your balcony.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, drive to Tarangire National Park with packed lunches. Focus on spotting Tanzanian endemics including Rufous-tailed Weaver and Yellow-collared Lovebird throughout your explorations in this park known for its high concentration of elephants.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Tarangire
itinerary.description: Spend an entire day exploring Tarangire Plains where you can observe numerous birds along with elephants. Return to your lodge for dinner after a fulfilling day of wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Departure from Arusha
itinerary.description: Depending on flight arrangements, there may be time for additional birdwatching in Tarangire before returning to Arusha for outbound connections.
